_comment: Second mutation config for @attestrack/schema: the consent/tracking/portal validators and their parse helpers. Kept SEPARATE from stryker.conf.json so the INV-B-15 Explore SQL gate keeps its own high bar (break=85) while this broader validator surface gets its own honest threshold. `pnpm mutation` runs both. Excluded: index.ts (re-exports only) and the explore-sql gate (covered by stryker.conf.json). Known EQUIVALENT survivors (score achieved: 97.4): (1) jurisdiction.schema.ts `if (!raw) return fallback` -> `if (false)`: without the fast path, null coerces through JSON.parse to a schema-invalid value and ''/undefined throw — every branch still returns `fallback`; (2) portal-saved-queries.schema.ts `if (!raw) return []` — same shape, same result; (3) portal-saved-queries.schema.ts catch-body removal — `parsed` stays undefined, the following !Array.isArray check returns the same `[]`. These guards are intentional fast paths, kept for clarity; not refactorable without making behavior depend on JSON.parse coercion subtleties.
